    const text=(button.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
    const rect=button.getBoundingClientRect();
    const style=window.getComputedStyle(button);
    return {text, aria:button.getAttribute('aria-label')||'', cls:String(button.className||''), x:Math.round(rect.x), y:Math.round(rect.y), w:Math.round(rect.width), h:Math.round(rect.height), visible:style.display!=='none'&&style.visibility!=='hidden'&&Number(style.opacity||'1')>0&&rect.width>0&&rect.height>0};
  }).filter((entry)=>entry.visible).slice(0,80));
  console.log('\nROUTE',route);
  console.log(JSON.stringify(info,null,2));
  await page.close();
}
await browser.close();

const { chromium } = require('@playwright/test');
const BASE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:3000';
(async()=>{
  const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true});
  const context=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:1100}});
  await context.request.get(`${BASE_URL}/portal`).catch(()=>null);
  const res=await context.request.post(`${BASE_URL}/portal/api/login`,{headers:{'content-type':'application/json','x-portal-variant':'portal'},data:{email:'demo-full@purelyautomation.dev',password:'pura-demo-local'},failOnStatusCode:false});
  const json=await res.json().catch(()=>null);
  if(!res.ok()||!json?.ok) throw new Error('login failed');
  const page=await context.newPage();
  await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/portal/app/services/reporting`,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded',timeout:120000});
  await page.waitForTimeout(4000);
  const data=await page.evaluate(()=>Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).map((button, index)=>{
    const rect=button.getBoundingClientRect();
    const style=window.getComputedStyle(button);
    return {
      index,
      text:(button.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(),
      aria:button.getAttribute('aria-label'),
      visible:rect.width>0&&rect.height>0&&style.visibility!=='hidden'&&style.display!=='none'&&Number(style.opacity||'1')>0,
      x:Math.round(rect.x), y:Math.round(rect.y), w:Math.round(rect.width), h:Math.round(rect.height)
    }
  }).filter(x=>x.visible));
  console.log(JSON.stringify(data.slice(0,120), null, 2));
  await browser.close();
})();

const { chromium } = require('@playwright/test');
(async()=>{
  const BASE='http://127.0.0.1:3000';
  const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true});
  const context=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:1100}});
  await context.request.get(BASE+'/portal',{timeout:120000,failOnStatusCode:false}).catch(()=>null);
  const res=await context.request.post(BASE+'/portal/api/login',{headers:{'content-type':'application/json','x-portal-variant':'portal'},data:{email:'demo-full@purelyautomation.dev',password:'pura-demo-local'},timeout:120000,failOnStatusCode:false});
  const json=await res.json().catch(()=>null);
  if(!res.ok()||!json?.ok) throw new Error('login failed '+res.status());
  const page=await context.newPage();
  async function snap(route){
    await page.goto(BASE+route,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded',timeout:120000}).catch(()=>null);
    await page.waitForTimeout(4000);
    const info=await page.evaluate(()=>{
      const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].map((el)=>({
        text:(el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(),
        aria:el.getAttribute('aria-label')||'',
        role:el.getAttribute('role')||'',
        visible:(()=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); const s=getComputedStyle(el); return r.width>0&&r.height>0&&s.visibility!=='hidden'&&s.display!=='none'&&Number(s.opacity||'1')>0;})(),
        x:Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().x),y:Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().y),w:Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().width),h:Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().height)
      })).filter((b)=>b.visible);
      const body=(document.body.innerText||'').slice(0,4000);
      return {url:location.href,title:document.title,body,buttons:buttons.slice(0,80)};
    });
    return info;
  }
  const reporting=await snap('/portal/app/services/reporting');
  const funnel=await snap('/portal/app/services/funnel-builder');
  await page.goto(BASE+'/portal/app/services/funnel-builder',{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded',timeout:120000}).catch(()=>null);
  await page.waitForTimeout(4000);
  await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Forms'}).click({force:true,timeout:30000}).catch(()=>null);
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  const forms=await page.evaluate(()=>({
    url:location.href,
    body:(document.body.innerText||'').slice(0,4000),
    buttons:[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].map((el)=>({
      text:(el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(),aria:el.getAttribute('aria-label')||'',visible:(()=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); const s=getComputedStyle(el); return r.width>0&&r.height>0&&s.visibility!=='hidden'&&s.display!=='none'&&Number(s.opacity||'1')>0;})(),x:Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().x),y:Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().y),w:Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().width),h:Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().height)
    })).filter((b)=>b.visible).slice(0,80)
  }));
  console.log(JSON.stringify({reporting,funnel,forms},null,2));
  await browser.close();
})().catch((error)=>{console.error(error); process.exit(1);});

import { chromium } from '@playwright/test';

const BASE_URL = process.env.PURA_BASE_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:3000';
const DEMO_EMAIL = process.env.PURA_DEMO_EMAIL || 'demo-full@purelyautomation.dev';
const DEMO_PASSWORD = process.env.PURA_DEMO_PASSWORD || 'pura-demo-local';

async function login(context) {
  await context.request.get(`${BASE_URL}/portal`, { timeout: 300000, failOnStatusCode: false }).catch(() => null);
  const res = await context.request.post(`${BASE_URL}/portal/api/login`, {
    timeout: 300000,
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-portal-variant': 'portal' },
    data: { email: DEMO_EMAIL, password: DEMO_PASSWORD },
    failOnStatusCode: false,
  });
  const json = await res.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!res.ok || !json?.ok) throw new Error(`Login failed: ${res.status()} ${JSON.stringify(json)}`);
}

async function waitForSettled(page, ms = 1200) {
  await page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded', { timeout: 60000 }).catch(() => null);
  await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle', { timeout: 3000 }).catch(() => null);
  await page.waitForTimeout(ms);
}

async function summarizePopup(page, labelPattern) {
  return await page.evaluate((labelPatternString) => {
    const labels = new RegExp(labelPatternString, 'i');
    const isVisible = (el) => {
      if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
      return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && style.visibility !== 'hidden' && style.display !== 'none' && Number(style.opacity || '1') > 0;
    };
    const candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div, section, aside'))
      .filter((el) => isVisible(el) && labels.test((el.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()))
      .map((el) => {
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const texts = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('button, a, [role="button"], [role="option"]'))
          .filter(isVisible)
          .map((node) => (node.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim())
          .filter(Boolean);
        return { text: (el.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(), rect: { x: Math.round(rect.x), y: Math.round(rect.y), w: Math.round(rect.width), h: Math.round(rect.height) }, items: texts };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => (b.rect.w * b.rect.h) - (a.rect.w * a.rect.h));
    return candidates[0] || null;
  }, labelPattern.source || String(labelPattern));
}

async function buttonRect(locator) {
  const box = await locator.boundingBox();
  return box ? { x: Math.round(box.x), y: Math.round(box.y), w: Math.round(box.width), h: Math.round(box.height) } : null;
}

const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
try {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1400 } });
  await login(context);
  const page = await context.newPage();
  page.setDefaultTimeout(120000);

  const result = {};

  await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/portal/app/services/inbox/email`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 120000 });
  await waitForSettled(page, 1800);
  const searchInput = page.getByPlaceholder('Search mail');
  await searchInput.waitFor({ state: 'visible' });
  const searchRect = await buttonRect(searchInput);
  await searchInput.click({ force: true });
  await page.waitForTimeout(600);
  const searchPopup = await summarizePopup(page, /Recent searches|Matches|No matching conversations/i);
  const filterButton = page.getByLabel('Mail filters');
  const filterRect = await buttonRect(filterButton);
  await filterButton.click({ force: true });
  await page.waitForTimeout(700);
  const filterPopup = await summarizePopup(page, /Filters.*Who.*From.*Subject.*Has words.*Date.*Mailbox.*Search scope.*Clear filters/i);
  result.inbox = {
    searchInput: searchRect,
    searchPopup,
    filterButton: filterRect,
    filterPopup,
  };

  await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/portal/app/services/reporting`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 120000 });
  await waitForSettled(page, 1800);
  const moreButtons = page.getByLabel('More');
  const moreCount = await moreButtons.count();
  const reportingButtonRect = moreCount ? await buttonRect(moreButtons.first()) : null;
  if (moreCount) {
    await moreButtons.first().click({ force: true });
    await page.waitForTimeout(700);
  }
  const reportingPopup = await summarizePopup(page, /Add to dashboard|Go to/i);
  result.reporting = { moreCount, reportingButtonRect, reportingPopup };

  await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/portal/app/services/funnel-builder`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 120000 });
  await waitForSettled(page, 1800);
  const funnelActions = page.getByLabel('Funnel actions');
  const funnelCount = await funnelActions.count();
  const funnelButtonRect = funnelCount ? await buttonRect(funnelActions.first()) : null;
  if (funnelCount) {
    await funnelActions.first().click({ force: true });
    await page.waitForTimeout(700);
  }
  const funnelPopup = await summarizePopup(page, /Actions.*Edit.*Preview.*(Live|Settings).*Delete/i);
  result.funnel = { funnelCount, funnelButtonRect, funnelPopup };

  const formsTab = page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Forms$/i }).first();
  await formsTab.click({ force: true });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  const formActions = page.getByLabel('Form actions');
  const formCount = await formActions.count();
  const formButtonRect = formCount ? await buttonRect(formActions.first()) : null;
  if (formCount) {
    await formActions.first().click({ force: true });
    await page.waitForTimeout(700);
  }
  const formPopup = await summarizePopup(page, /Actions.*Edit.*Responses.*Preview.*(Live|Settings).*Delete/i);
  result.forms = { formCount, formButtonRect, formPopup };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
} finally {
  await browser.close().catch(() => null);
}
EOF

const BASE='http://127.0.0.1:3000';
(async()=>{
  const browser = await chromium.launch({headless:true, executablePath:'/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome', args:['--no-sandbox']});
  const context = await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:1200}});
  const login = await fetch(`${BASE}/portal/api/login`, {method:'POST', headers:{'content-type':'application/json','x-portal-variant':'portal'}, body: JSON.stringify({email:'demo-full@purelyautomation.dev', password:'pura-demo-local'})});
  const cookie = login.headers.get('set-cookie') || '';
  const token = cookie.match(/pa\.portal\.session=([^;]+)/)?.[1];
  await context.setExtraHTTPHeaders({cookie:`pa.portal.session=${token}`});
  await context.addCookies([{name:'pa.portal.session', value:token, url:BASE, httpOnly:true, sameSite:'Lax'}]);
  const page = await context.newPage();
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/portal/app/services/funnel-builder`, {waitUntil:'domcontentloaded', timeout:120000});
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !(document.body.textContent || '').includes('Loading funnels…'), {timeout:120000}).catch(()=>null);
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  await page.locator('button[aria-label="Funnel actions"]').first().click({force:true});
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  const funnel = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const trigger = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Funnel actions"]');
    const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).filter((node) => /Edit|Preview|Settings|Delete|Set status:/i.test((node.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()));
    const card = trigger?.closest('.rounded-3xl');
    const tr = trigger?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const first = items[0]?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cr = card?.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      trigger: tr ? {left: tr.left, top: tr.top, right: tr.right, bottom: tr.bottom} : null,
      firstItem: first ? {left: first.left, top: first.top, right: first.right, bottom: first.bottom} : null,
      card: cr ? {left: cr.left, top: cr.top, right: cr.right, bottom: cr.bottom, height: cr.height} : null,
      itemCount: items.length,
      viewport: {width: window.innerWidth, height: window.innerHeight},
    };
  });
  await page.getByRole('button', {name:/^Forms$/i}).first().click({force:true});
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !(document.body.textContent || '').includes('Loading forms…'), {timeout:120000}).catch(()=>null);
  await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
  await page.locator('button[aria-label="Form actions"]').first().click({force:true});
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  const form = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const trigger = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Form actions"]');
    const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).filter((node) => /Edit|Responses|Preview|Settings|Delete/i.test((node.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()));
    const card = trigger?.closest('.rounded-3xl');
    const tr = trigger?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const first = items[0]?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cr = card?.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      trigger: tr ? {left: tr.left, top: tr.top, right: tr.right, bottom: tr.bottom} : null,
      firstItem: first ? {left: first.left, top: first.top, right: first.right, bottom: first.bottom} : null,
      card: cr ? {left: cr.left, top: cr.top, right: cr.right, bottom: cr.bottom, height: cr.height} : null,
      itemCount: items.length,
      viewport: {width: window.innerWidth, height: window.innerHeight},
    };
  });
  console.log(JSON.stringify({funnel, form}, null, 2));
  await browser.close();
})().catch(err=>{console.error(err); process.exit(1);});

GitHub Copilot: I’m checking the Pura working-memory implementation so I can explain what the user is actually seeing, not just guess from the label.

Searched for regex `working memory|workingMemory|activeWorkingMemory` (`**/src/app/portal/app/ai-chat/PortalAiChatClient.tsx`), 26 results

Searched for regex `workingMemory|normalizeWorkingMemory` (`**/src/lib/**/*.ts`), no results

Searched codebase for "Pura working memory UI meaning what is shown to user why displayed", 12 results

**What It Is**
- In Pura, “working memory” is basically the thread’s short-term context card, not some hidden permanent profile about the user.
- It shows Pura’s current condensed understanding of that specific conversation: a short thread summary plus a few recent pieces of work it has done in that thread.
- In the UI, that card is built in PortalAiChatClient.tsx.

**What The User Is Looking At**
- A brief summary of the thread so far.
- A “last updated” timestamp for when that summary was refreshed.
- Up to the last 3 recent runs / work items Pura did in that thread.
- Sometimes a status line like “blocked on...” or “ready next...” if that thread has an unresolved step or an obvious next action.

**Why It’s Displayed**
- It gives the user a quick snapshot of what Pura currently thinks is going on, without forcing them to reread the whole thread.
- It helps the user sanity-check Pura’s context: “Yes, that’s what we’re working on,” or “No, that summary is off.”
- It makes long threads easier to resume, especially when the conversation has already done multiple actions.

**What It Means For The User**
- It’s basically: “Here’s the current mental model Pura is using for this thread.”
- If the summary is right, the user can keep going confidently.
- If it looks wrong or stale, that’s a signal the user may want to correct Pura in plain English.

**What It Is Not**
- It’s not some separate database record the user is supposed to manually manage.
- It’s not a universal memory across all chats; it’s tied to the active thread.
- It’s not shown all the time. The app only shows it when the thread is developed enough to be useful, and it hides it when more important live-progress / blocked-next-step cards are active. That gating logic is in PortalAiChatClient.tsx.

**Under The Hood**
- The memory object is normalized from thread context and contains:
- a thread summary
- a summary updated timestamp
- recent run history
- That logic is in PortalAiChatClient.tsx.
- The thread-specific memory is stored per thread and read as the active thread’s working memory in PortalAiChatClient.tsx and PortalAiChatClient.tsx.

Short version: it’s a visible “Pura’s current context for this thread” card, mainly there to help the user resume long conversations and verify that Pura is tracking the right thing.

If you want, I can also suggest a clearer label than “Working memory” that would make more sense to end users.

**Map answer**
- Yes, you can show a map in the portal.
- Practically, you’d want the Google Maps JavaScript API for rendering the map, and either Places Details or Geocoding to get coordinates for each lead.
- Your existing Google Places integration already handles place IDs and formatted addresses in googlePlaces.ts, but for map pins you’d want to extend it to also request/store geometry (`lat`/`lng`).
- So the answer is: yes, absolutely feasible, and the cleanest next step is to store coordinates on scraped leads and render them as markers in a portal map view.

Completed: *Trace slow load path* (1/5)

**Root Cause**
- The page was not just “slow”; the settings endpoint was timing out in Prisma with a P2024 on the lead-scraping settings lookup, which is why it sat there forever and then failed.
- The client was also making the first screen wait on a burst of extra requests for tags, assignees, custom variables, and nurture campaigns, so one clogged DB path could drag the whole load down.

**What I Changed**
- Hardened route.ts so a timed-out saved-settings query no longer takes down the whole page; it now falls back to normalized defaults and nullable credits instead of returning a hard failure.
- Reworked PortalLeadScrapingClient.tsx so first load only waits on the critical settings payload.
- Moved the leads-only support fetches behind the initial render, so tags, assignees, custom vars, and nurture campaigns now load in the background instead of blocking the screen.
- Added stale-request protection so an older load cannot come back late and clobber a newer tab state.
- Removed extra reload pressure by narrowing the main load callback dependencies so it does not refetch settings just because leads search plumbing changes.

**Refresh Behavior**
- Non-initial refresh states are now lighter than before: they only track the critical settings refresh, while the leads-side support data fills in afterward without replacing the whole screen.
- That means refresh should interrupt less, not more.

**Validation**
- Both patched files validate cleanly with no file-level errors.
- I did not run a full browser smoke yet, but the concrete timeout path and the blocking boot pattern are both addressed now.

If you want, I can do one more targeted pass next and inspect the live dev output again after you hit the lead-scraping tabs, just to confirm the P2024 stall is actually gone.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client');
const { encode } = require('next-auth/jwt');

function readEnvValue(name) {
  const envPath = path.join(process.cwd(), '.env.local');
  const text = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8');
  const line = text.split('\n').find((entry) => entry.startsWith(`${name}=`));
  if (!line) return null;
  const raw = line.slice(name.length + 1).trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  if ((raw.startsWith('"') && raw.endsWith('"')) || (raw.startsWith("'") && raw.endsWith("'"))) {
    return raw.slice(1, -1);
  }
  return raw;
}

(async () => {
  const prisma = new PrismaClient();
  try {
    const secret = process.env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET || readEnvValue('NEXTAUTH_SECRET');
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: 'demo-full@purelyautomation.dev' }, select: { id: true, email: true, name: true, role: true } });
    const token = await encode({
      secret,
      token: { uid: user.id, memberUid: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name, role: user.role },
      maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30,
    });

      console.log('\nROUTE', route, 'STATUS', res.status);
      console.log(text.slice(0, 2500));
    }
  } finally {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  }
})().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exit(1);
});

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { chromium } = require('@playwright/test');
const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client');
const { encode } = require('next-auth/jwt');

function readEnvValue(name) {
  const envPath = path.join(process.cwd(), '.env.local');
  const text = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8');
  const line = text.split('\n').find((entry) => entry.startsWith(`${name}=`));
  if (!line) return null;
  const raw = line.slice(name.length + 1).trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  if ((raw.startsWith('"') && raw.endsWith('"')) || (raw.startsWith("'") && raw.endsWith("'"))) return raw.slice(1, -1);
  return raw;
}

(async () => {
  const prisma = new PrismaClient();
  const secret = process.env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET || readEnvValue('NEXTAUTH_SECRET');
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: 'demo-full@purelyautomation.dev' }, select: { id: true, email: true, name: true, role: true } });
  const token = await encode({ secret, token: { uid: user.id, memberUid: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name, role: user.role }, maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30 });
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, executablePath: '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome', args: ['--no-sandbox'] });
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1400 } });
  await context.addCookies([{ name: 'pa.portal.session', value: token, domain: '127.0.0.1', path: '/', httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'Lax' }]);
  for (const route of ['/portal/app/services/lead-scraping', '/portal/app/services/lead-scraping/scraper', '/portal/app/services/lead-scraping?tab=b2c']) {
    const page = await context.newPage();
    await page.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:3000${route}`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 120000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(2500);
    const metrics = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const main = document.querySelector('main');
      const root = document.querySelector('[data-pa-portal-topbar-hidden]') || document.documentElement;
      const frame = document.querySelector('.h-full.min-h-0.overflow-hidden.overscroll-none > .h-full.min-h-0.overflow-hidden.border-y.border-zinc-200.bg-white') || document.querySelector('section.flex.h-full.min-h-0.items-center.justify-center.overflow-hidden');
      const body = document.body;
      const docEl = document.documentElement;
      const rect = (el) => el ? el.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON() : null;
      return {
        viewport: { width: window.innerWidth, height: window.innerHeight },
        bodyScrollHeight: body.scrollHeight,
        documentScrollHeight: docEl.scrollHeight,
        rootClass: root?.getAttribute('data-pa-portal-topbar-hidden') ?? null,
        mainRect: rect(main),
        frameRect: rect(frame),
        mainPaddingTop: main ? getComputedStyle(main).paddingTop : null,
      };
    });
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ route, metrics }, null, 2));
    await page.close();
  }
  await browser.close();
  await prisma.$disconnect();
})().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });

  const line = text.split('\n').find((entry) => entry.startsWith(`${name}=`));
  if (!line) return null;
  const raw = line.slice(name.length + 1).trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  if ((raw.startsWith('"') && raw.endsWith('"')) || (raw.startsWith("'") && raw.endsWith("'"))) return raw.slice(1, -1);
  return raw;
}

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import { encode } from 'next-auth/jwt';

function readEnvValue(name) {
  const text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), '.env.local'), 'utf8');
  const line = text.split('\n').find((entry) => entry.startsWith(`${name}=`));
  if (!line) return null;
  const raw = line.slice(name.length + 1).trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  if ((raw.startsWith('"') && raw.endsWith('"')) || (raw.startsWith("'") && raw.endsWith("'"))) return raw.slice(1, -1);
  return raw;
}

const prisma = new PrismaClient();
try {
  const secret = process.env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET || readEnvValue('NEXTAUTH_SECRET');
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { email: 'demo-full@purelyautomation.dev' },
    select: { id: true, email: true, name: true, role: true },
  });
  const token = await encode({
    secret,
    token: { uid: user.id, memberUid: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name, role: user.role },
    maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30,
  });

  const res = await fetch('http://localhost:3000/api/portal/lead-scraping/settings', {
    headers: {
      cookie: `pa.portal.session=${token}`,
      'x-pa-app': 'portal',
      'x-portal-variant': 'portal',
    },
  });
  const json = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    status: res.status,
    aiCallsUnlocked: json.aiCallsUnlocked,
    aiCampaignsLiteLength: Array.isArray(json.aiCampaignsLite) ? json.aiCampaignsLite.length : null,
    firstCampaign: Array.isArray(json.aiCampaignsLite) ? json.aiCampaignsLite[0] ?? null : null,
  }, null, 2));
} finally {
  await prisma.$disconnect();
}
EOF

Completed: *Reproduce localhost demo flow* (1/3)

**What Was Actually Wrong**
- You were right: this was not “fixed” by hiding a spinner.
- I reproduced the localhost demo-account path and found the real failure: on cold localhost loads, the settings route was timing out into an empty `aiCampaignsLite: []`, and the client was treating that as final, which is why you got `No campaigns found.` even though the demo account has 4 campaigns.
- I also confirmed the dedicated campaigns route could stall long enough on localhost that the old 10s client timeout would abort it before data came back.

**What I Changed**
- In route.ts, I increased the AI campaign preload timeout and kept the schema-compat path in place so localhost cold starts stop collapsing into a fake empty list.
- In PortalLeadScrapingClient.tsx, I changed the cache/hydration logic so an unlocked account with an empty preloaded campaign list is treated as “not resolved yet,” not “no campaigns exist.”
- In that same client file, I increased the direct campaign fetch timeout from `10000` to `20000`, so the UI stays in `Loading campaigns…` while localhost is actually still loading.

**What I Verified**
- Direct localhost probe now returns all 4 campaigns from both the settings preload and the dedicated campaigns route.
- The browser repro on localhost now shows the settings payload and session cache both carrying 4 campaigns (`fh demo` first), which was the missing data path before.
- There is still a separate hydration-mismatch warning in the page shell, but that is not the campaign-data bug you called out.

**Next Step**
- Reload the lead-scraping settings page once so the updated client code takes over the old tab state.
- If you want, I can chase the remaining hydration mismatch next, since that’s the other noisy thing showing up in the localhost repro.

const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:3000';
const jar = new Map();
function store(res){
  const raw = res.headers.get('set-cookie');
  if (!raw) return;
  const parts = raw.split(/, (?=[^;]+?=)/g);
  for (const item of parts) {
    const first = item.split(';')[0];
    const idx = first.indexOf('=');
    if (idx > 0) jar.set(first.slice(0, idx), first.slice(idx + 1));
  }
}
function cookieHeader(){
  return Array.from(jar.entries()).map(([k,v]) => `${k}=${v}`).join('; ');
}
async function timed(label, url, init = {}) {
  const started = Date.now();
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 25000);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { ...init, signal: controller.signal, headers: { ...(init.headers || {}), ...(cookieHeader() ? { cookie: cookieHeader() } : {}) } });

    console.log(JSON.stringify({ label, error: String(error), ms: Date.now() - started }, null, 2));
    return null;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timeout);
  }
}

Completed: *Patch dashboard layout* (2/5)

**Done**
- Removed the extra dashboard page chrome in page.tsx so the dashboard starts immediately instead of burning vertical space above the first row.
- Updated the shared dashboard card shell in PortalDashboardClient.tsx so widgets no longer use the top accent lines, internal widget scrolling is gone, Pura attention/open tasks are cleaner, and the colored reporting cards now render as actual tinted cards with the glow preserved.
- Increased dashboard widget minimum sizes in portalDashboardLayout.ts so existing and newly added widgets inherit the larger no-scroll sizing.
- Hid Chat and Report during dashboard edit mode in PortalShell.tsx, and it comes back when editing ends.

**Load Fix**
- Changed the dashboard client in PortalDashboardClient.tsx so a slow layout fetch no longer hard-fails the whole page: it renders a safe default dashboard first, then refreshes the saved layout when the response arrives.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean.
- Local verification shows `/api/portal/dashboard?scope=default` returns `200`, `/portal/app` returns `200`, and the dashboard now loads instead of surfacing the timeout message.

**Hydration Mismatch**
- Plain English: the server rendered one version of the page HTML, then the browser rendered a different version during React startup, so React complains and rebuilds that part on the client.
- Usual causes are client-only values like `window`, `localStorage`, viewport size, timestamps, random IDs, or state that differs between server render and browser render.
- It’s a render-consistency bug, not the same thing as the dashboard data timeout bug.

import { chromium } from '@playwright/test';

const BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:3000';
const TIMEOUT_TEXT = 'Dashboard data is taking too long to load. Please wait a moment and try again.';
const markersToCheck = [
  'Keep building this dashboard',
  'Hours saved',
  'Pura attention',
  'Edit mode: drag cards and resize from the corner',
];

async function loginToken() {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/portal/api/login`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'content-type': 'application/json',
      'x-portal-variant': 'portal',
      'x-pa-return-token': '1',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ email: 'demo-full@purelyautomation.dev', password: 'pura-demo-local' }),
  });
  const body = await res.json().catch(() => null);
  const token = typeof body?.token === 'string' ? body.token : '';
  if (!res.ok || !token) {
    throw new Error(`Login failed: status=${res.status} body=${JSON.stringify(body)}`);
  }
  return token;
}

const consoleMessages = [];
let browser;
try {
  const token = await loginToken();
  browser = await chromium.launch({
    headless: true,
    executablePath: '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome',
    args: ['--no-sandbox'],
  });

  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1200 } });
  await context.setExtraHTTPHeaders({ 'x-portal-variant': 'portal' });
  await context.addCookies([
    {
      name: 'pa.portal.session',
      value: token,
      url: BASE,
      httpOnly: true,
      sameSite: 'Lax',
    },
  ]);

  const page = await context.newPage();
  page.on('console', (msg) => {
    consoleMessages.push({ type: msg.type(), text: msg.text() });
  });
  page.on('pageerror', (error) => {
    consoleMessages.push({ type: 'pageerror', text: String(error?.message || error) });
  });

  const response = await page.goto(`${BASE}/portal/app`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 120000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(10000);

  const visibleTimeout = await page.getByText(TIMEOUT_TEXT, { exact: true }).isVisible().catch(() => false);
  const bodyText = await page.locator('body').innerText().catch(() => '');
  const bodyHasTimeout = bodyText.includes(TIMEOUT_TEXT);
  const consoleHasTimeout = consoleMessages.some((entry) => entry.text.includes(TIMEOUT_TEXT));
  const markers = {};
  for (const marker of markersToCheck) {
    markers[marker] = await page.getByText(marker, { exact: false }).isVisible().catch(() => false);
  }

  const currentUrl = page.url();
  const title = await page.title().catch(() => '');

  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    ok: true,
    status: response?.status?.() ?? null,
    url: currentUrl,
    title,
    visibleTimeout,
    bodyHasTimeout,
    consoleHasTimeout,
    markers,
    consoleMessages: consoleMessages.slice(0, 50),
  }, null, 2));

  await browser.close();
} catch (error) {
  if (browser) await browser.close().catch(() => {});
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: String(error), consoleMessages }, null, 2));
  process.exitCode = 1;
}

- The full-page background you are looking at is primarily controlled by the portal shell, not by AI Receptionist itself: the outer shell container uses `bg-brand-mist` in PortalShell.tsx.
- AI Receptionist is rendered as `children` inside the shell’s `<main>` in PortalShell.tsx. That `<main>` adds the page padding, which is why you see the shell background around the inner content.
- In the AI Receptionist client, the Activity tab only decides which panel renders; it does not currently set the page background. The outer wrapper is just a plain `<div>` in PortalAiReceptionistClient.tsx.
- The white area inside Activity is just the card itself: `rounded-3xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-6` in PortalAiReceptionistClient.tsx.

**What That Means**
- `bg-brand-mist` in PortalShell controls the visible “page” background behind AI Receptionist.
- `bg-white` in the Activity card controls only the card surface, not the whole page.
- The shell does not know about the internal `tab === "activity"` state; that state exists only inside AI Receptionist. So there is no existing Activity-specific full-page background switch right now.

**Why My Bad Change Looked Wrong**
- I changed the child page layer instead of the shell layer: I added a white wrapper inside AI Receptionist and removed the card border, so I whitened a nested container but did not change the actual shell background source.
- The exact control chain is: PortalShell outer background → PortalShell padded `<main>` area → AI Receptionist Activity card. If you want the whole Activity page white, the real control point is the shell layer, or a route-aware full-bleed wrapper that replaces what the shell background is showing through.

Yep — the weird “it’s loading but I can’t tell” state had two real problems, and I fixed both.

**Fixed**
- The runtime error came from the toast hook: both screens were calling the strict toast hook even when no provider was present. I added a safe optional hook in ToastProvider.tsx and switched these pages to use it:
  - PortalAiReceptionistClient.tsx
  - PortalMissedCallTextBackClient.tsx
- The loading shell was way too faint, so I increased the contrast and added an obvious `Loading…` label in PortalPageLoadingShell.tsx.
- AI Receptionist settings was still rendering the Save button while the settings body was in the initial loading shell. I hid that until the settings actually load in PortalAiReceptionistClient.tsx.
- Missed-call text back now uses the stronger shell too in PortalMissedCallTextBackClient.tsx.

**Result**
- No more `useToast must be used within <ToastProvider>` crash from these screens.
- The loading state should now read as an actual loading state instead of “blank page with a random Save button.”
- Targeted validation passed on all touched files.
